items.title_zh: “男人戴锯齿形发带从来不好看”：推特用户的言论吸引了网上的恶搞
items.title_en: ‘Guys Never Look Good in Zigzag Hairband’: Twitter User’s Remark Attracts Trolls Online
items.summary_zh: 一名网友因对戴锯齿形发带的男性发表负面言论而遭到猛烈抨击。他贴出了一张头带的照片，并写道，“没有人戴过这个东西看起来很好看”。
items.summary_en: An internet user was slammed for his negative remark on men wearing the zigzag hairband. He posted a picture of the headband and wrote, 'no guy has ever looked good wearing this thing'.

items.title_zh: 您知道阿塞拜疆的 Ateshgah 与印度教文化有联系吗？
items.title_en: Did You Know Ateshgah In Azerbaijan Has This Connection With The Hindu Culture?
items.summary_zh: Atesghan 在 20 世纪 70 年代被改建为博物馆。
items.summary_en: The Atesghan was converted into a museum during the 1970s.

items.title_zh: 办公室员工“庆祝”休息，微软团队打乱表情包
items.title_en: Microsoft Teams Down Memes Take Over As Office Employees 'Celebrate' Break
items.summary_zh: 印度各地数千名用户的 Microsoft Teams 和 Outlook 无法使用，办公室员工正在用表情包庆祝这一中断。
items.summary_en: Microsoft Teams and Outlook are down for thousands of users across India and office employees are celebrating the break with memes.

items.title_zh: 金·卡戴珊 (Kim Kardashian) 在哈佛商学院演讲后遭到残酷攻击
items.title_en: Kim Kardashian Gets Brutally Trolled After Giving Lecture at Harvard Business School
items.summary_zh: 金·卡戴珊 (Kim Kardashian) 在哈佛商学院发表演讲，讲述了她的品牌 SKIMS 的成功和挑战。
items.summary_en: Kim Kardashian gave a lecture at Harvard Business School where she spoke about the success and challenges of her brand SKIMS.

items.title_zh: 索南·巴杰瓦 (Sonam Bajwa) 通过“萨拉”推文驳斥了与舒布曼·吉尔 (Shubhman Gill) 约会的谣言
items.title_en: Sonam Bajwa Dismisses Rumours of Dating Shubhman Gill With a 'Sara' Tweet
items.summary_zh: 在所有这些争议中，板球运动员舒布曼·吉尔 (Shubhman Gil) 与模特索南·巴杰瓦 (Sonam Bajwa) 握手的照片在社交媒体上疯传，并引起了热烈的反响。
items.summary_en: Amid all of these controversies, an image of the cricketer Shubhman Gil shaking hands with model Sonam Bajwa has gone viral on social media and attracted hilarious responses.
